zh-CN.name: 标书协作 Agent
zh-CN.summary: 拆解招标要求、建立应答台账，协助分章撰写和交付前复核
zh-CN.description:
读取招标文件后，它会整理资格条件、评分项、应答要求和待补材料，形成可追踪的应答台账。团队可以按章节分工撰写，再由它检查遗漏、前后矛盾和材料引用。

它适合帮助项目团队组织工作，不替代投标负责人对商务承诺、报价和最终文件的确认。

en-US.name: Tender Collaboration Agent
en-US.summary: Breaks down tender requirements, maintains a response ledger, and assists with section drafting and final checks.
en-US.description:
After reading a tender package, it organizes eligibility conditions, scoring items, response requirements, and missing materials into a traceable ledger. Teams can draft sections in parallel and use the Agent to check omissions, contradictions, and source references.

It helps a bid team organize the work. Commercial commitments, pricing, and the final submission remain with the responsible people.
